index.title: Place Orders or Schedule Appointments with an App
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Place Orders. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Place Orders or Schedule Appointments with an App. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help,
index.what_happened_excerpt: Someone sent a photo of a list of items to an app, which used the photo to place orders, and also sent a photo of a calendar to an app, which used the photo to schedule appointments
